progression._note: SPEC 9.4, 12.2, placeholders. Battle XP x level ratio (clamped) x (0.5 + leader charisma/100) x (1 + talent xp_bonus); a level costs level_xp x the class's XP rate; promotion to a stage opens at its level; every non-key stat grows at least once every growth_guarantee levels; classes with a branch lean promote only into next classes whose Holy/Evil/Neutral lean matches the unit's band.

standing._note: SPEC 9.5, 9.6, 10, placeholders. Reputation by squad alignment: liberating a town (holy +, evil -; towers the reverse) and each day spent in one. Shop prices -price_swing at reputation 100, +price_swing at 0.

economy._note: SPEC 15.1 and 16, placeholders. Income at noon per town and tower you hold; liberation bonus x (0.5 + reputation/100); a squad sells for sell_per_stage x stage per unit when you're broke; each shop stocks shop_items random items.

upkeep._note: SPEC 15.1, gold per unit per day, placeholders. Deploying a squad costs one day of its upkeep.

capture._note: SPEC 6.5, placeholders: ticks a squad with a ground unit must stay to liberate a town or tower; Sapper lines (the sapper tag) are faster; towns hint at hidden sites within hint_range hexes.

services._note: SPEC 15.1, placeholders. Revive restores full HP.
